title: InstructionsProviderDescriptor
description: Descriptor for a Pack-shipped Instructions Provider plug-in. Invoked exactly once per Run by the Initializer, before Control starts. Returns domain-specific RunContext properties (instructionsPayload + Pack-typed user config). Never writes to the Blackboard. Same sandboxing/versioning model as KSs but distinct contract.

instructionsPayloadSchemaRef.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the JSON Schema that the returned instructionsPayload conforms to. Pack-owned schema.
